text:
Eva Ramos: Hey @legal @security — Acme Bio signed the NDA (attached) and asked for a SOC 2 extract + a bridge-letter/ack so they can start a week-long POC. They want materials this week. Can we confirm: what exact pages we can share, required redactions, and whether we can issue a short-term bridge attestation? cc @eng-solutions

Max Chen: Legal here. Short answer: yes, we can provide a redacted extract and a bridge attestation. Need to follow our template and confirm no material changes since report date. Also we require customer NDA on file before sharing. ETA: I can produce the extract + bridge draft within 24–48h once I have the NDA copy and the SOC2 PDF we will redact.

Ana Iqbal: From Security: recommended extract = front page, opinion paragraph, scope page, and management assertion/signature. Redact control implementation details, internal diagrams, and any customer-specific logs. Also redact any IP or network ranges. If they request control narrative we need legal signoff (usually no).

Jo Park: For the POC side: we can get them a sandbox project and a temporary API key. Steps: 1) get NDA + bridge ack, 2) create sandbox org, 3) whitelist their IPs or provide client-side IP range, 4) temp creds expire after 7 days. I can do the org spin-up in ~4hrs once legal gives the go.

Liz Morales: Sales note — we offered trial credits for the POC and asked for timeline. No change to list pricing for now. If they want dedicated capacity during POC we need SOW. For bridge-letter asks we typically bundle with the NDA signature step.

Eva Ramos: @Max — attaching the NDA they uploaded: `Acme_Bio_NDA_signed.pdf`. Also they asked whether a redacted PDF extract is acceptable or whether we need to send a scanned signed letter. What's your preference?

Max Chen: Redacted PDF extract is fine. We'll produce: front page + scope + management assertion as a single redacted PDF and a separate signed bridge-letter (short attestation). Bridge-letter language: one paragraph confirming no material changes and valid for X months from issue date. I will use `SOC2_BRIDGE_TEMPLATE.docx`.

Ana Iqbal: Quick checklist I'll need before redaction: `- original SOC2 PDF` `- confirm report date` `- any control exceptions noted` `- intended recipients list`

Eva Ramos: Got it — sending the original SOC2 from their SD: `acme_soc2_2024-11.pdf` and a list of emails.

docsign-bot: DocuSign link posted: https://docusign.example.com/signed/0x12345 (customer-signed NDA).

Max Chen: Thanks. I'll produce the redacted extract + draft bridge and post here. Eva — please confirm recipients and whether they need countersignature on the bridge. If no countersignature needed we can issue signed scan; if they require countersignature we'll route via DocuSign (adds 1 business day).

Jo Park: If we go DocuSign for the bridge, note the POC spin-up will wait until the DocuSign completes (per legal). If they accept signed scan, I can start infra prep immediately after we post the extract (within the 4hr window).

Eva Ramos: Customer prefers immediate access; they said they can accept a signed scan for now. I'll flag that to Max.

Max Chen: OK. I'll redact and post the PDF + signed bridge scan here in ~6–8 hours. Marking as priority.

Ana Iqbal: One last item — please do not include the appendix that lists internal tester accounts or any SSH hostnames. Redact those if present.

Eva Ramos: Noted. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Max Chen: Posted redacted extract and signed bridge (redacted copies): https://internal-storage.example.com/redactions/acme_soc2_extract_redacted.pdf and https://internal-storage.example.com/bridge/acme_bridge_signed_scan.pdf. @Jo — you can proceed with sandbox spin-up when ready.

Jo Park: Spinning up sandbox now. ETA ~3.5h. I'll post the API key and whitelist details in a new thread under #support when ready.

Liz Morales: Adding internal tracker: Opportunity ID 9823 — POC start date set to tomorrow after infra ready.

Eva Ramos: Closing loop — forwarding links to Acme contact and confirming POC kickoff once infra live. Thanks all.
